name: agent-chain-wrapper
description: Run AgentChain as a CLI skill-style wrapper for reviewer-only checks from Codex, Kimi, and Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Review current Codex changes with another CLI.
interface.longDescription: Agent Chain Wrapper exposes the AgentChain binary as a CLI skill-style wrapper. By default the current Codex session writes code and AgentChain calls a selected external reviewer CLI, then Codex applies feedback and repeats until approved. Fully delegated pairs remain available when explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Use the current Codex session to code, then run AgentChain review with Kimi.
Review my current changes with AgentChain and Kimi.
Code in Codex, then use AgentChain reviewer-only mode for this project.
